name: clio-toolkit
description: Byrd Law Group's Clio Manage toolkit: connect to Clio, run deadline-first matter analysis, open new MVA matters, stand up the standard MVA pre-litigation workflow (tasks + Georgia deadlines), apply reusable task/deadline workflow templates to any matter, upload/edit/revise documents in Clio's document management (clio-documents), and draft client text updates from matter notes (clio-client-update).
